extracted.name: Soft Persimmon Cookies
extracted.description: This is a tasty recipe for soft persimmon cookies. These cake-like cookies are wonderfully sweet and delicious; a great use of autumn persimmons.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease or line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and salt together in a bowl.
Cream sugar with butter. Beat in persimmons and egg. Add flour mixture and mix until combined. Stir in chopped nuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls, 2 inches apart, onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
